items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: But Manuel could read, my teacher.

ctx.x: Why was there not many kids?

Well, Baton Rouge wasn't a big town to start with. Manuel had five pupils, and they had other guys who used to teach. Some kids used to take lessons from some of their teachers in school that taught. Incidentally, they had a real fine player, that just died up in San Francisco, named Wilbur Grancot(?). And this guy was from Baton Rouge, and he took lessons from one of them Catholic nuns.
